title: “World War 3 na!”
paragraphs: Every time may tension sa mundo, biglang may countdown prophets sa timeline.

Jesus already warned us:
“You will hear of wars and rumors of wars… see to it that you are not alarmed.”

Hindi Niya sinabi, “Mag-panic kayo.”
Hindi Niya sinabi, “Gumawa kayo ng viral conspiracy threads.”
He said: do not be deceived.

Every generation believed sila na ang final chapter.
Roman Empire. World Wars. Cold War. Y2K. Pandemic.

Pero alam mo kung ano ang rare ngayon?
Steady believers.
Discerning believers.
Hindi madaling ma-sway ng fear headlines.

If this is the End Times,
then hysteria is not the badge of honor.
Faithfulness is.

Hindi tayo tinawag para maging anxious broadcasters.
Tinawag tayo para maging anchored witnesses.

Kung malapit na talaga?
Mas lalo dapat calm.
Mas lalo dapat prayerful.
Mas lalo dapat rooted in truth.

Fear spreads fast.
Discernment spreads slower.
Pero mas matibay.

Hindi fear ang calling natin.
Readiness ang calling natin.
At readiness looks like discipline, not drama.
